title: Prediction of intraoperative acquired pressure injury in elderly cardiac surgery patients via machine learning: model development with the MIMIC-IV and external validation.
summary: A stacked ensemble predicts intraoperative pressure injury in elderly cardiac-surgery patients with internal cross-validation and external Nanjing validation. Published in BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making.
ai_technology: A stacked machine-learning ensemble predicts intraoperative pressure injury from perioperative patient variables.
organization: School of Science, China Pharmaceutical University, Nanjing, China

evidence.tested: Full Methods/Results in NCBI PMC BioC; multiple imputation, bootstrap calibration and external cohort reviewed.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: A stacked machine-learning ensemble predicts intraoperative pressure injury from perioperative patient variables.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
